subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Minimalist Podcast Gear, Regaining Your Focus with One Question, Beautiful Animation, and More

bullets.title: Lost in Starlight
bullets.note:
The visuals in this film blew my mind. I never really thought of South Korea as an animation powerhouse, but this changes things. This particular film was co-written and directed by [Han Ji-won](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm11853957/), who earned the distinction of being the youngest South Korean to direct a theatrically released animated film ([_Clearer Than You Think_](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MNchUEPt8yM)). Here’s part of the description: “When an astronaut leaves Earth for Mars, the vast infinite space divides star-crossed lovers in this animated romance that crosses the cosmos.”  
​  
Honestly, that teaser doesn’t do it justice, but you shouldn’t read more about it or watch the trailers, which give away too much. Just try 15 minutes and see what you think.  
​  
For my English-speaking friends: to enjoy the cadence and spirit of the original Korean, which I highly recommend, scroll over the captions bubble in the bottom-right corner of the Netflix viewing window, then choose “Korean \[Original\]” under “Audio” and “English” under “Subtitles.”

bullets.title: RØDE PSA1+ Professional Studio Arm
bullets.note: This is the latest addition to my minimalist podcast toolkit. The [Shure MV7+](https://www.amazon.com/Shure-MV7-Microphone-Certified-Podcasting/dp/B0CTJ7PVN1/) microphone, the [Logitech Brio 4K](https://www.amazon.com/Logitech-Calling-Noise-Canceling-Correction-Microsoft/dp/B09NBWWP79/) webcam, and [Riverside](https://riverside.fm/) for remote recordings completes the setup. From the description: “The PSA1+ is the ultimate studio boom arm for podcasters, streamers, and broadcasters. Its innovative parallelogram spring design ensures ultra-smooth movement and precise microphone placement in any position, while its fully damped internal springs and neoprene arm cover eliminate mechanical noise for completely silent operation.” This arm literally took me 1–2 minutes to set up, and it’s compact enough that you could throw it in a suitcase.
